question: Oda-sensei, heso!! As I was browsing through the list of birthdays, I realized that nobody from Alabasta other than Vivi had official birthdays yet, so I did my best to come up with some! How is: {| style="margin:auto; width:650px; align:center;" | |King Cobra (2/13) "kobura koku'ou" = 213;(13) is king and bu is (2) | |Karoo (11/8) "karu--" = 118;( -- becomes u (08)) and ka is (11) |} {| style="margin:auto; width:650px; align:center;" | |Pell (8/23) "hayabusa = 823(Japanese for Falcon); both ha and ya are (8),bu is (2) and sa is (3) | |Chaka (4/26) "Jakkaru" = 426 (Japanese for Jackal);ji/shi is (4), ka is (2) and ru is (6) |} {| style="margin:auto; width:650px; align:center;" | |Koza (5/26) "ko--za" = 526;ko/go is (5) and za is (26) | |Igaram (12/6) "igaramu" = 126;i is (1), ga is (2) and mu is (6) |} ...? (20 years old)
answer: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!! (shock) Sure. [T/N: It's hard to explain, but basically, all these birthdays are based off "number puns"- something that's rather common in Japan. These "number puns", known as "goro awase" (ゴロ合わせ), use the various methods of counting that exist within the Japanese language to turn normal terms into numbers. For example, above, the word for "freely" (Jiyuni 自由に) sounds like the word for "twelve" (jyuni 十二), hence "freely" can be written as "12". Nevertheless, some of these are definitely a stretch.]
name: Alabasta
